About me

Who I Am

I'm a full-stack developer with 14+ years of experience shipping production web applications. I specialize in React on the front end and Node.js + PostgreSQL on the back end, with a strong emphasis on performance and accessibility.

Before going full-stack I worked as a UX designer, so I care deeply about the intersection of aesthetics and engineering. When I'm not coding, I'm contributing to open-source projects and writing on my blog.
